firstPlayerRule: The youngest player starts the first Tournament round by rolling the Season dice and choosing a die first.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: Before the Tournament, players draft their Power cards in the Prelude by choosing cards simultaneously and passing the rest left.
After the first player chooses a die, the others choose clockwise. Individual turns then proceed clockwise from the first player.
The player to the current first player’s left starts the next round.
